note: Standard Delaware corporation (direct listing) with generic 'any lawful act' purpose clause and no public benefit designation; does have dual-class (Class A/B) supervoting stock for founder control, which is a governance-control feature distinct from a true mission-lock provision. Included for negative/contrast example. No mission exists to protect (M1, M2 both 'Not affirmative') and no PBC/equivalent statutory designation exists either (M3 'Not affirmative') — founder supervoting stock is control concentration, not mission entrenchment, and has no bearing on any of the three rules.
